summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan for the active_goal read path: harness extension, red-then-green regression cases plus a unified resolve_goal_text() chain covering both --print and --update-todo, documentation of the precedence and conflict rule, then deploy and the full gate set. Premise re-validation confirmed every cited line and reproduced the defect live in this repository (non-empty active_goal, no Goal line in specs/TODO.md). The plan carries the research report's settled conflict rule (non-empty active_goal wins over a hand-edited TODO.md line) and the report's finding that --print mode renders no Goal line from any source today, which is why the mode gate must go.
